summary: The original specification of the File Transfer Protocol (FTP) for moving files between hosts on the ARPANET, written by Abhay Bhushan. Its aims were to promote file sharing, encourage indirect use of remote computers, shield users from differences in file storage, and transfer data reliably. It is designed mainly for use by programs but can be used from a terminal. It was replaced by RFC 542.

eli5.summary: A set of rules that lets one computer hand a file to another computer, even if the two store files differently, so people can share their work.

questions: how does the original file transfer protocol work
